title: Artifact Registry File Structure Schema
description: Schema for defining file structure validation rules with shared field definitions. Supports both JSON and non-JSON file types via glob patterns.

description.description: Human-readable description of the file's purpose within the artifact definition

minCount.description: Minimum number of matching files (0 = optional, 1+ = required)

maxCount.description: Maximum number of matching files (for patterns)

FileDefinition.description: Defines a file entry in the structure. For non-JSON file types (e.g., images), schemaRef is optional since schema validation does not apply.

FilePath.description: Valid glob-style path pattern. Supports wildcards: '*' matches any characters within a path segment, '**' matches across path segments, '?' matches a single character. Examples: '*.json', 'images/**/*.png', 'assets/?con.svg'.

SchemaReference.description: Array of schema references for validation - base definition to be overridden by specific schemas for maxItems constraint

FileSize.description: The size of the file in bytes

MaxSize.description: Maximum size for entire files collection
